module: Small example of using render views (RenderViewManagerInstance): creates a view named 'Demo view 1' rendered into a named texture, moves its camera in a circle and displays it in an ImGui window. To be loaded by hand with extensions.load('render_viewDemo'); serves as a template for a modder who wants a virtual camera to a texture.
notes: The view's name is its unique identifier; renderView.namedTexTargetColor receives this name, and imUtils.texObj('#<name>') retrieves the texture for ImGui.
luaOwned = true makes the view be deleted when the garbage collector collects it.
View parameters in the example: resolution 512x256, fov 75, near 0.1, far 2000, renderCubemap false, renderEditorIcons true.
The text 'Hello world view :)' is drawn via debugDrawer:drawTextAdvanced at (20, 20, 0).
The view is never destroyed by the extension: no onExtensionUnloaded.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: creates the view on the first call, moves the camera (position sin/cos of simulated time, height 1.5), draws a debug text and displays the view's texture in the ImGui window 'Render view test'.

dtSim.desc: Simulated duration (s), added to a local timer.
